33:A story can't be sent on its own. The only way a story reaches work is through the sprint: a story in the Backlog waits until it is moved into Next sprint and the sprint is sent, and a story in Next sprint goes when the sprint does. Nothing in Planning, its rows, their menus, the open story, the keyboard, the palette, or the ribbon, sends a single story, and nothing elsewhere sends a story by any other route: a story can't be dragged or copied into the chat input or the queue to be sent from there, and its menu has no "Send" or "Edit in chat input". The chat input's own prompts are not stories and are sent as ever; once a prompt is a story, the sprint is its only way to work. To send one story at once, it is the only story in Next sprint when Send sprint is pressed. A story that failed or was cancelled is sent again the same way, with the next sprint.

content.text:
Story tasks can no longer be sent again from the Tasks tab or the Ask pane, but none of it is compiled or tested. The build script calls `piton compile`, which this sandbox blocks; I only checked that the files parse with rustfmt.

Most of this was already true in the code. No story menu has "Send" or "Edit in chat input", and a story can't be dragged into the chat input or the queue. The only thing that sends stories is Send sprint, and New story, Ctrl+N, Duplicate and an Ask card's "Add to sprint" all add to the end of Next sprint.

The gap was the Tasks tab and the Ask pane. A story's task, one of its steps, or its chain's later steps could be re-sent there with Resend or "Send to Code/Spec", which sent the story outside the sprint.

- **What changed:** those tasks now have no Resend button and no other-mode button, and the resend path refuses them as well. The spec says a failed or cancelled story goes again only with the next sprint.
- **How it knows:** `PromptMode` keeps the names the plan's stories were sent as, from a new `Planning::story_tasks()`. It's refreshed by the observer added for the pause.
- **One consequence:** a task you send to the other mode from a story's task is now treated as part of the story too. Its own Resend and other-mode button are gone.

The spec step's summary doesn't match the built spec on one point. It says accepted proposals go to the end of Next sprint, but `#creating` and `#proposal-cards` say an accepted new-story proposal goes to the Backlog. I left the code following the spec, which sends them to the Backlog.

The spec step's summary doesn't match the built spec on one point. It says accepted proposals go to the end of Next sprint, but `#creating` and `#proposal-cards` say an accepted new-story proposal goes to the Backlog. I left the code following the spec, which sends them to the Backlog.
